g.text: Precision vector icons, navigation controls, technology chips, and academic crests.
TECHNICAL LINK ICON SUITE (24 × 24 PX · 1.75 PX WIRE GAUGE)
• 24x24 px pixel-aligned stroke bounds · 1.75 px stroke width matching circuit traces
• Universal hover feedback state: stroke shifts to #b42318 (Action Potential Crimson)
• Inset controls for toggling between full LIF circuit exploration and reader page mode
• Synchronized 6-symbol rail navigation (I(t), C=200pF, R=100MΩ, V≥Vth, spike, out)
MODULAR TECHNOLOGY SKILL CHIPS (VERIFIED FROM RESUME & SITE)
• Auto-layout chip geometry: Height 28 px · Border radius 2 px · IBM Plex Mono 9 px
• Active status dot indicates research & flagship production usage
• AIC Hack for Humanity: 1st Place win for Headcount (Nov 2026)
Calls older adults in wildfire evacuation zones until accounted for
• Instructional Assistant in Python: Sep 2024 – Dec 2024
Assisted intro lab (60+ students/wk) in NumPy, pandas & scikit-learn
